description: This file defines a list of optional bundled clusters, provides utility functions to check their inclusion based on environment variables and package configuration, and exports related constants and functions.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if a given cluster name is included in the list of optional bundled clusters.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines whether optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variable 'OPENCLAW_INCLUDE_OPTIONAL_BUNDLED'.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if the package JSON indicates a released bundled install via a non-empty npm specification string.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides whether a specific cluster should be built, considering release status, environment settings, and whether the cluster is optional.
